  return (
    <nav aria-label="Progress" className={cn('w-full', className)}>
      <ol className="flex items-start gap-2">
        {steps.map((step, index) => {
          const isComplete = index < currentStep
          const isActive = index === currentStep
          const isUpcoming = index > currentStep
          const accent = step.accentClass ?? 'text-atria-accent'

          return (
            <li
              key={step.id}
              className="relative flex flex-1 flex-col items-center text-center"
              aria-current={isActive ? 'step' : undefined}
            >
              <div className="flex w-full items-center">
                {index > 0 && (
                  <div
                    className={cn(
                      'hidden sm:block flex-1 h-0.5 -mr-2',
                      isComplete ? 'bg-atria-accent' : 'bg-atria-border',
                    )}
                  />
                )}
                <div
                  className={cn(
                    'z-10 flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full border-2 text-sm font-semibold',
                    isComplete && 'border-atria-accent bg-atria-accent text-atria-on-accent',
                    isActive && `border-atria-accent bg-atria-accent-quiet ${accent}`,
                    isUpcoming && 'border-atria-border bg-atria-surface text-atria-text-muted',
                  )}
                >
                  {isComplete ? (
                    <svg
                      className="h-5 w-5"
                      fill="none"
                      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                      stroke="currentColor"
                      strokeWidth={3}
                    >
                      <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M5 13l4 4L19 7" />
                    </svg>
                  ) : (
                    <span>{index + 1}</span>
                  )}
                </div>
                {index < steps.length - 1 && (
                  <div
                    className={cn(
                      'hidden sm:block flex-1 h-0.5 -ml-2',
                      isComplete ? 'bg-atria-accent' : 'bg-atria-border',
                    )}
                  />
                )}
              </div>
              <div className="mt-2 px-1">
                <p
                  className={cn(
                    'text-sm font-medium',
                    isUpcoming ? 'text-atria-text-muted' : 'text-atria-ink',
                  )}
                >
                  {step.label}
                </p>
                {step.description && (
                  <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-atria-text-secondary">
                    {step.description}
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>
            </li>
          )
        })}
      </ol>
    </nav>
  )

import path from 'node:path'
import react from '@vitejs/plugin-react'
import { defineConfig } from 'vitest/config'
import type { PluginOption } from 'vite'

// https://vite.dev/config/
export default defineConfig(async ({ mode }) => {
  const plugins: PluginOption[] = [react()]

  // Tailwind's Vite plugin loads a native Oxide binding. Loading it as a
  // static import forces Vite's config bundler to process that native .node
  // file, which can fail in some Windows sandboxes. Tests run in jsdom and do
  // not need CSS processing, so skip the plugin in test mode.
  if (mode !== 'test') {
    const { default: tailwindcss } = await import('@tailwindcss/vite')
    plugins.push(tailwindcss())
  }

  return {
    plugins,
    resolve: {
      alias: {
        '@': path.resolve(__dirname, './src'),
      },
    },
    test: {
      environment: 'jsdom',
      exclude: ['node_modules/**', 'dist/**', 'tests/e2e/**'],
      globals: true,
      setupFiles: './src/test/setup.ts',
      css: true,
      pool: 'threads',
      fileParallelism: false,
      maxWorkers: 1,
    },
  }
})

 161:         ? prev.filter((id) => id !== clientId)
 162:         : [...prev, clientId],
 163:     )
 164:   }
 165: 
 166:   const openBulkSchedule = () => {
 167:     setBulkForm({
 168:       caregiverId: caregivers?.[0]?.clerkUserId ?? '',
 169:       startDate: todayInputValue(),
 170:       endDate: todayInputValue(),
 171:       startTime: '09:00',
 172:       endTime: '13:00',
 173:       rate: 28.5,
 174:     })
 175:     setBulkError(null)
 176:     setBulkMessage(null)
 177:     setBulkOpen(true)
 178:   }
 179: 
 180:   const openAddress = (client: Doc<'clients'>) => {
 181:     setAddressClientId(client._id)
 182:     const address = client.serviceAddress
 183:     setAddressForm({
 184:       line1: address?.line1 ?? '',
 185:       line2: address?.line2 ?? '',
 186:       city: address?.city ?? '',
 187:       state: address?.state ?? '',
 188:       postalCode: address?.postalCode ?? '',
 189:       country: address?.country ?? '',
 190:       latitude: address?.latitude?.toString() ?? '',
 191:       longitude: address?.longitude?.toString() ?? '',
 192:     })
 193:     setAddressError(null)
 194:     setAddressOpen(true)
 195:   }
 196: 
 197:   const handleSaveAddress = async () => {
 198:     if (!clerkOrgId || !addressClientId) return
 199:     setAddressError(null)
 200: 
 201:     const latitude = addressForm.latitude.trim()
 202:       ? Number(addressForm.latitude)
 203:       : undefined
 204:     const longitude = addressForm.longitude.trim()
 205:       ? Number(addressForm.longitude)
 206:       : undefined
 207: 
 208:     try {
 209:       await updateServiceAddress({
 210:         clerkOrgId,
 211:         clientId: addressClientId as Id<'clients'>,
 212:         serviceAddress: {
 213:           line1: addressForm.line1.trim(),
 214:           line2: addressForm.line2.trim() || undefined,
 215:           city: addressForm.city.trim(),
 216:           state: addressForm.state.trim(),
 217:           postalCode: addressForm.postalCode.trim(),
 218:           country: addressForm.country.trim() || undefined,
 219:           latitude,
 220:           longitude,
 221:         },
 222:       })
 223:       setAddressOpen(false)
 224:       setAddressClientId(null)
 225:     } catch (err) {
 226:       setAddressError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to save address.')
 227:     }
 228:   }
 229: 
 230:   const handleSchedule = async () => {
 231:     if (!clerkOrgId || !scheduleClientId) return
 232:     setScheduleError(null)
 233: 
 234:     if (!scheduleForm.caregiverId || !scheduleForm.date) {
 235:       setScheduleError('Please select a caregiver and date.')
 236:       return
 237:     }
 238: 
 239:     const client = clients.find((c: Doc<'clients'>) => c._id === scheduleClientId)
 240:     if (!client) return
 241: 
 242:     const scheduledStart = `${scheduleForm.date}T${scheduleForm.startTime}:00Z`
 243:     const scheduledEnd = `${scheduleForm.date}T${scheduleForm.endTime}:00Z`
 244: 
 245:     try {
 246:       await createShift({
 247:         clerkOrgId,
 248:         clientId: scheduleClientId as Id<'clients'>,
 249:         caregiverId: scheduleForm.caregiverId,
 250:         scheduledStart,
 251:         scheduledEnd,
 252:         serviceType: client.serviceType,
 253:         rate: scheduleForm.rate,
 254:       })
 255:       setScheduleOpen(false)
 256:       setScheduleClientId(null)
 257:     } catch (err) {
 258:       setScheduleError(
 259:         err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to schedule shift.',
 260:       )
 261:     }
 262:   }
 263: 
 264:   const handleBulkSchedule = async () => {
 265:     if (!clerkOrgId) return
 266:     setBulkError(null)
 267:     setBulkMessage(null)
 268: 
 269:     if (selectedClientIds.length === 0) {
 270:       setBulkError('Select at least one client.')
 271:       return
 272:     }
 273:     if (!bulkForm.caregiverId) {
 274:       setBulkError('Select a caregiver.')
 275:       return
 276:     }
 277: 
 278:     try {
 279:       const result = await createManyShifts({
 280:         clerkOrgId,
 281:         clientIds: selectedClientIds as Id<'clients'>[],
 282:         caregiverId: bulkForm.caregiverId,
 283:         startDate: bulkForm.startDate,
 284:         endDate: bulkForm.endDate,
 285:         startTime: bulkForm.startTime,
 286:         endTime: bulkForm.endTime,
 287:         rate: bulkForm.rate,
 288:       })
 289:       setBulkMessage(
 290:         `Created ${result.created} shift${result.created !== 1 ? 's' : ''}.`,
 291:       )
 292:       setSelectedClientIds([])
 293:       setBulkOpen(false)
 294:     } catch (err) {
 295:       setBulkError(
 296:         err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to schedule shifts.',
 297:       )
 298:     }
 299:   }
 300: 
 301:   return (
 302:     <div className="space-y-6">
 303:       <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
 304:         <div>
 305:           <h1 className="text-lg font-semibold text-atria-ink">Clients</h1>
 306:           <p className="text-sm text-atria-muted">
 307:             {clients.length} client{clients.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}
 308:           </p>
 309:         </div>
 310:         <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
 311:           <Button
 312:             variant="secondary"
 313:             disabled={selectedClientIds.length === 0}
 314:             onClick={openBulkSchedule}
 315:           >
 316:             <CalendarPlus className="h-4 w-4" />
 317:             Bulk schedule{' '}
 318:             {selectedClientIds.length > 0 && `(${selectedClientIds.length})`}
 319:           </Button>
 320:           <Button variant="primary" onClick={() => setShowForm(!showForm)}>
 321:             {showForm ? 'Cancel' : 'Add Client'}
 322:           </Button>
 323:         </div>
 324:       </div>
 325: 
 326:       {bulkMessage && (
 327:         <div className="rounded-md bg-atria-success-bg px-3 py-2 text-sm text-atria-success">
 328:           {bulkMessage}
 329:         </div>
 330:       )}
 331: 
 332:       {tenantSettings?.shiftGeofence.enabled &&
 333:         clients.some(
 334:           (client: Doc<'clients'>) =>
 335:             client.serviceAddress?.latitude === undefined ||
 336:             client.serviceAddress?.longitude === undefined,
 337:         ) && (
 338:           <div className="rounded-md border border-atria-warning/30 bg-atria-warning-bg px-4 py-3 text-sm text-atria-warning">
 339:             Geofence is enabled, but some clients are missing latitude/longitude
 340:             coordinates. Clock-in/out will be blocked for those clients until a
 341:             service address is completed.
 342:           </div>
 343:         )}
 344: 
 345:       {showForm && (
 346:         <Card>
 347:           <CardContent className="p-4 space-y-3">
 348:             <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
 349:               <div>
 350:                 <label className="text-xs font-medium text-atria-muted uppercase tracking-wider">
 351:                   Name
 352:                 </label>
 353:                 <Input
 354:                   value={form.displayName}
 355:                   onChange={(e) =>
 356:                     setForm((f) => ({ ...f, displayName: e.target.value }))
 357:                   }
 358:                   placeholder="Client name"
 359:                 />
 360:               </div>
 361:               <div>
 362:                 <label className="text-xs font-medium text-atria-muted uppercase tracking-wider">
 363:                   Service Type
 364:                 </label>
 365:                 <Select
 366:                   value={form.serviceType}
 367:                   onChange={(e) =>
 368:                     setForm((f) => ({
 369:                       ...f,
 370:                       serviceType: e.target.value as 'SLS' | 'ILS',
 371:                     }))
 372:                   }
 373:                 >
 374:                   <option value="SLS">SLS</option>
 375:                   <option value="ILS">ILS</option>
 376:                 </Select>
 377:               </div>
 378:               <div>
 379:                 <label className="text-xs font-medium text-atria-muted uppercase tracking-wider">
 380:                   Authorization Hours
 381:                 </label>
 382:                 <Input
 383:                   type="number"
 384:                   value={form.authorizationHours}
 385:                   onChange={(e) =>
 386:                     setForm((f) => ({
 387:                       ...f,
 388:                       authorizationHours: Number(e.target.value),
 389:                     }))
 390:                   }
 391:                 />
 392:               </div>
 393:               <div>
 394:                 <label className="text-xs font-medium text-atria-muted uppercase tracking-wider">
 395:                   Risk Flags
 396:                 </label>
 397:                 <Input
 398:                   value={form.riskFlags}
 399:                   onChange={(e) =>
 400:                     setForm((f) => ({ ...f, riskFlags: e.target.value }))
 401:                   }
 402:                   placeholder="Comma-separated"
 403:                 />
 404:               </div>
 405:             </div>
 406:             <Button variant="primary" onClick={handleCreate}>
 407:               Save Client
 408:             </Button>
 409:           </CardContent>
 410:         </Card>
 411:       )}
 412: 
 413:       <Card>
 414:         <CardContent className="p-0">
 415:           {clients.length === 0 ? (
 416:             <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-12 text-center">
 417:               <div className="inline-flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-atria-border/50 mb-3">
 418:                 <Users className="h-6 w-6 text-atria-muted" />
 419:               </div>
 420:               <p className="text-sm font-medium text-atria-ink">
 421:                 No clients yet
 422:               </p>
 423:               <p className="text-xs text-atria-muted mt-1 max-w-xs">
 424:                 Add your first client to start scheduling shifts.

 426:             </div>
 427:           ) : (
 428:             <Table>
 429:               <TableHead>
 430:                 <TableRow>

 436:                         clients.length > 0
 437:                       }
 438:                       onChange={(event) =>

 441:                             ? clients.map((client: Doc<'clients'>) => client._id)
 442:                             : [],
 443:                         )
 444:                       }
 445:                       className="h-4 w-4 rounded border-atria-border text-atria-accent"
 446:                     />
 447:                   </TableHeader>
 448:                   <TableHeader>Name</TableHeader>
 449:                   <TableHeader>Service</TableHeader>
 450:                   <TableHeader>Auth Hours</TableHeader>
 451:                   <TableHeader>Risk Flags</TableHeader>
 452:                   <TableHeader className="w-32">Action</TableHeader>
 453:                 </TableRow>
 454:               </TableHead>
 455:               <TableBody>
 456:                 {clients.map((client: Doc<'clients'>) => (

 464:                       />
 465:                     </TableCell>
 466:                     <TableCell className="font-medium">
 467:                       {client.displayName}
 468:                     </TableCell>
 469:                     <TableCell>
 470:                       <Badge variant="default">{client.serviceType}</Badge>
 471:                     </TableCell>
 472:                     <TableCell>{client.authorizationHours}</TableCell>
 473:                     <TableCell>
 474:                       <div className="flex gap-1 flex-wrap">
 475:                         {client.riskFlags.map((flag: string) => (

 477:                             {flag}
 478:                           </Badge>
 479:                         ))}
 480:                       </div>
 481:                     </TableCell>
 482:                     <TableCell>
 483:                       <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
 484:                         <Button
 485:                           variant="ghost"
 486:                           size="sm"
 487:                           onClick={() => openAddress(client)}
 488:                         >
 489:                           <MapPin className="h-4 w-4 mr-1" />
 490:                           Address
 491:                         </Button>
 492:                         <Button
 493:                           variant="ghost"
 494:                           size="sm"
 495:                           onClick={() => openSchedule(client._id)}
 496:                         >
 497:                           <CalendarPlus className="h-4 w-4 mr-1" />
 498:                           Schedule
 499:                         </Button>
 500:                       </div>
 501:                     </TableCell>
 502:                   </TableRow>
 503:                 ))}
 504:               </TableBody>
 505:             </Table>
 506:           )}
 507:         </CardContent>

 544:               <Input
 545:                 type="date"
 546:                 value={scheduleForm.date}
 547:                 onChange={(e) =>

 549:                 }
 550:                 className="mt-1"
 551:               />
 552:             </div>
 553:             <div>
 554:               <label className="text-xs font-medium text-atria-muted uppercase tracking-wider">
 555:                 Start
 556:               </label>
 557:               <Input
 558:                 type="time"
 559:                 value={scheduleForm.startTime}
 560:                 onChange={(e) =>

 562:                 }
 563:                 className="mt-1"
 564:               />
 565:             </div>
 566:             <div>
 567:               <label className="text-xs font-medium text-atria-muted uppercase tracking-wider">
 568:                 End
 569:               </label>
 570:               <Input
 571:                 type="time"

 573:                 onChange={(e) =>

 575:                 }
 576:                 className="mt-1"
 577:               />
 578:             </div>

 582:               Rate ($/hr)
 583:             </label>
 584:             <Input

 587:               value={scheduleForm.rate}
 588:               onChange={(e) =>

 619:             {selectedClientIds.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''} across a date range.

 621:           <div>

 630:               className="mt-1"

 653:                 className="mt-1"

 665:                 }
 666:                 className="mt-1"
 667:               />
 668:             </div>
 669:           </div>
 670:           <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
 671:             <div>
 672:               <label className="text-xs font-medium text-atria-muted uppercase tracking-wider">
 673:                 Start
 674:               </label>
 675:               <Input
 676:                 type="time"
 677:                 value={bulkForm.startTime}
 678:                 onChange={(e) =>
 679:                   setBulkForm((f) => ({ ...f, startTime: e.target.value }))
 680:                 }
 681:                 className="mt-1"
 682:               />
 683:             </div>
 684:             <div>

 686:                 End

 688:               <Input
 689:                 type="time"
 690:                 value={bulkForm.endTime}
 691:                 onChange={(e) =>
 692:                   setBulkForm((f) => ({ ...f, endTime: e.target.value }))
 693:                 }
 694:                 className="mt-1"
 695:               />
 696:             </div>
 697:             <div>
 698:               <label className="text-xs font-medium text-atria-muted uppercase tracking-wider">
 699:                 Rate ($/hr)

 701:               <Input
 702:                 type="number"
 703:                 step="0.01"
 704:                 value={bulkForm.rate}
 705:                 onChange={(e) =>

 707:                 }
 708:                 className="mt-1"
 709:               />

 777:                 value={addressForm.state}

 781:                 className="mt-1"

 797:           <div>
 798:             <label className="text-xs font-medium text-atria-muted uppercase tracking-wider">
 799:               Country
 800:             </label>
 801:             <Input
 802:               value={addressForm.country}
 803:               onChange={(e) =>
 804:                 setAddressForm((f) => ({ ...f, country: e.target.value }))
 805:               }
 806:               className="mt-1"
 807:             />

 809:           <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
 810:             <div>
 811:               <label className="text-xs font-medium text-atria-muted uppercase tracking-wider">
 812:                 Latitude
 813:               </label>
 814:               <Input
 815:                 type="number"
 816:                 step="any"
 817:                 value={addressForm.latitude}
 818:                 onChange={(e) =>
 819:                   setAddressForm((f) => ({ ...f, latitude: e.target.value }))

 821:                 className="mt-1"
 822:               />
 823:             </div>
